PrivacyPolicyPage.title: Privacy Policy
PrivacyPolicyPage.subtitle: How Omnider collects, uses, and protects your information across the web platform, mobile apps, and messaging channels.
intro: This Privacy Policy explains how Omnider processes personal data across the Omnider Web Platform, Android and iOS apps, panels, APIs, and related services.
By using the Services, you acknowledge that you have read and understood this Policy.

sections.title: Scope
paragraphs: This Policy covers the web platform, mobile apps, customer and partner panels, and connected channels such as WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger, Telegram, email, SMS, and web chat.

sections.title: Information we collect
paragraphs: We may collect account and billing details, team roles, conversation content, contact and channel metadata, campaign data, uploaded files, and usage logs.
list: Name, email, phone, company, and authentication data

sections.title: How we use data
paragraphs: We use data to provide the Service, keep it secure, support customers, bill subscriptions, meet legal duties, and improve the product.

sections.title: Sharing and retention
paragraphs: We do not sell personal data. Data may be processed by subprocessors, connected messaging platforms, or when required by law. Retention depends on subscription needs and legal requirements.

sections.title: Your rights
paragraphs: Where applicable, you may request access, correction, deletion, objection, or account/data deletion. Requests are handled after identity verification.

PrivacyPolicyPage.contactBody: For privacy questions or rights requests, email us.

TermsOfUsePage.title: Terms of Use
TermsOfUsePage.subtitle: Rules that govern access to Omnider products, panels, mobile apps, and integrated messaging services.
intro: These Terms of Use are a binding agreement between you and Omnider for the Omnider Web Platform, mobile apps, panels, APIs, and related services.
By creating an account or using the Services, you accept these Terms and the Privacy Policy.

sections.title: Acceptable use
paragraphs: You agree to use the Services in line with the law, these Terms, and the rules of any connected third-party platforms.
list: Spam, illegal content, or platform-policy violations are prohibited
You are responsible for account security and your team’s actions
APIs and integrations are subject to both Omnider and platform terms

sections.title: Accounts and billing
paragraphs: Paid features are billed under pricing or order terms. Access may be suspended or terminated for non-payment or material breach.

sections.title: Third-party platforms
paragraphs: Channels such as WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger, and Telegram remain subject to their own terms. Omnider is not responsible for platform changes, outages, or enforcement actions.

sections.title: Intellectual property
paragraphs: Omnider software, branding, and documentation belong to Omnider. These Terms grant a license to use the Services, not ownership.

sections.title: Liability and governing law
paragraphs: Services are provided as available. To the extent allowed by law, Omnider’s liability is limited. These Terms are governed by the laws of the Republic of Türkiye, without prejudice to mandatory consumer protections.

TermsOfUsePage.contactBody: Questions about these Terms? Email us.
